book.name: Mbouŋ to Yes Israela
book.title: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela Buk Song—Psalms

content: Yes Israela tighason Maaron pa iuul di, leso tineep poia muul

content.text: Muuŋ, ndug Zion isami kat. Ve sawa to Yoova iuul ghiit ve taneep poia muul, nene igham lolood poia kat.
Eemoghon taghur ila kat maau. Taghaze pa taghita vibiiŋ moghon. Mbo 14:7, 85:1
Sawa tonenen, tiniid iza, ve taŋiŋ kat.
Ŋgar to Yoova igham pait, ndug ndug tighita, ve tisaav tighaze: “Wai, Yoova igham uraat tintina pa yes Israela!”
Nene onoon. Yoova igham uraat tintina kat pait.
Tovenen nighason ghom nighaze uul ghei, leso nineep poia muul, inimale uman itap ve igham ya maakadi to Negev tireer muul.
Yes to titaŋtaŋ, ve tivazog aniiŋ,
muri pale tilup aniiŋ todi anoŋa, ve tilool toman lolodi poia. Mbaŋ 20:19,31; 1Kor 3:6+
Onoon kat, yes to titaŋtaŋ, ve timbaad aniiŋ uvedi tila pa vazogiiŋ,
muri pale timbaad aniiŋ anoŋa, ve tilool toman lolodi poia, ve timuul tila pa paanu.
